downloads.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (ASCSA page states these Corinth archaeological data/basemaps are licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0)
downloads.licenseMetadata: Page-level attribution; raster archive has no per-file metadata sidecar
downloads.crsLimit: Archive contains TIFF and worldfile only; TIFF tags do not declare a coordinate reference system. The worldfile bounds are in unspecified map units; do not load/reproject as known UTM without independent CRS identification.
downloads.temporalCoverage: Modern topographic base derived from current/modern DEM; no ancient temporal coverage. ASCSA maps page identifies the basemap context and elsewhere identifies ASTER GDEM as a NASA/METI product.
downloads.crsSummary: Undeclared; only worldfile affine coordinates present. No EPSG code or PRJ file.

recommendations.romanCorinth: Candidate base only. Polygon layer is buildings/structures with per-feature ChronEarly/ChronLate but includes ranges from 525 BCE to at least 1802 CE; line layer mixes Roman/Classical features and chronology fields include post-antique endpoints. Filter each record and re-check cited excavation/source before asserting a c. 50 CE footprint.
recommendations.acrocorinth: Candidate spatial layer; supplied metadata does not give a period-specific coverage. Its placement cannot be assumed to represent a 1st-century state without feature archaeology.
recommendations.cityWalls: Candidate context only; DBF contains categories Archaic, Classical and Late Roman, so it is not a single Roman-period wall outline.
recommendations.contours: The 100 m contours are an appropriate broad modern relief reference, not a period-specific surface. The archive lacks a declared CRS; retain as image-only until CRS is independently established.
recommendations.modernInfrastructure: Exclude modern canals, roads, reservoirs, shorelines, or labels from any reconstructed ancient map unless the layer is independently period-filtered and supported.
